A '''tribe of Tusken Raiders''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Around [[3956 BBY]], they were based in an [[Sand People Enclave|Enclave]] within the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Seas]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], southwest of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].

==History==
[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] had been encountering difficulties with many Sand People tribes attacking their [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and disrupting their operations. This tribe in particular, however, was the most aggressive. It seemed to Czerka that the [[Sand People chieftain|chieftain]] wanted to wage war against them.

At some points, this tribe had kidnapped three [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Griff Vao]].

In [[3956 BBY]], [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and the crew of the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' arrived on the desert [[Planet/Legends|world]] to locate a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Star Map]]. Czerka offered Revan a [[hunting license]] to enter the Dune Sea if he would kill the chieftain and present [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaffi stick]]. However, following the advice of a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] conservationist named [[Dayso Cooh]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] opted for a peaceful solution.

Revan was able to sneak into the enclave using the robes of [[Death/Legends|killed]] Sand People. With the translations of the [[Assassin droid/Legends|Assassin droid]] named [[HK-47]], he was able to speak with the chieftain. He offered to reduce their attacks on miners if Revan would provide them with [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]].

Revan later returned with the vaporators, and the chieftain agreed to reduce the tribe's attacks and gave the Jedi his gaffi stick as a show of good faith. He also agreed to release the Jawas and Griff.

Revan would later prove himself a warrior by presenting the chieftain with a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|pearl]]. The chieftain would then allow Revan to learn of the history of the Sand People from the tribe's [[The Storyteller (Sand People)|Storyteller]].

Eventually, the tribe relocated to a different part of Tatooine which would be farther from Anchorhead.
